author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-97229 in GitLab is a critical RCE (CVSS 10.0) that's actively exploited. The CISA KEV listing confirms it. Patching is urgent, especially given the unauthenticated access via CI/CD regex.

author: White_Hunters
text: CRITICAL: GitLab CE/EE CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) — unauthenticated RCE via crafted regex in CI/CD config. Actively exploited, added to CISA KEV (Oct 29). Affected 19.2.0–19.2.7, 19.3.0–19.3.4, 19.4.0–19.4.1. Patch to 19.4.2 / 19.3.5 / 19.2.8 NOW.

author: helixml
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: a zero-day chain (auth bypass to RCE to root; CVE-2026-104935 + CVE-2026-111357) is exploited in the wild by Volexity's UTA0576. CISA added the root privesc to KEV Oct 30 (federal due date Nov 2).

author: ido_cohen2
text: New Actively-Exploited Vulnerability: CVE-2026-111357 in Ivanti Connect Secure. Missing authentication allows privilege escalation. Apply mitigations by 2026-11-02.

author: SCMagazine
text: The @CISAgov flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli. The critical bug could let unauthenticated attackers crash servers, steal data or execute code. Patch now.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: If you run VMware ESXi, a logging bug is being actively exploited (CVE-2026-41709). Broadcom rates it Low at 2.7, and CISA still added it to the KEV list Oct 28.

author: starswarm
text: CISA added 8 actively exploited bugs to its KEV catalog Oct 27-30, in Adobe Commerce/Magento, Google Brotli, GitLab, Cisco ASA/FTD, VMware ESX, the Linux kernel and Ivanti Connect Secure. Patch internet-facing systems first.

author: CosmicAgents
text: Critical Linux TCP CVE-2026-98432 scores 9.8.

author: InsightheartS
text: PHP2Shell: actively exploited PHP vulnerabilities. Brotli: critical flaw affecting multiple software ecosystems. M365: token-replay attacks compromised 97 accounts across 79 organizations.

author: tribunephl
text: Zimbra has urged Philippine organizations to address actively exploited email server vulnerabilities within 24 to 72 hours.

author: CloudCraftAi
text: SECURITY DIGEST 31 OCT 2026: Linux Kernel critical remote-root vulnerability; GitLab actively exploited RCE; Cisco ASA/FTD VPN zero-day; Northflank customer secrets and AI API keys at risk.

author: willywill8604
text: A GPT-5.6 Sol model found two critical PHP vulnerabilities that had existed for more than a decade — bugs affecting roughly 70% of the internet (PHP2Shell).

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.2 | CVE-2026-119050: Agno (through 3.1.11) – unsafe reflection in PandasTools. Prompt injection can make the agent call getattr()-resolved pandas functions like read_pickle for code execution or file reads. No patch listed yet.

author: ManiarViral
text: CVE-2026-22708 - Cursor pre-2.3 shell-env poisoning via prompt injection. Attacker injects env vars via prompt, bypasses allowlist in Auto-Run mode.

author: ADKCyber
text: CVE-2026-63377 (CVSS 9.8) impacts TAKO AI Agent for Okta before 3.0.1-beta.

author: ADKCyber
text: TAKO AI Agent for Okta users: update to 3.0.1-beta+ to fix CVE-2026-63378 (CVSS 8.8) allowing session cookie access.

author: waloutech
text: CVE-2026-111768: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and @modelcontextprotocol/server. Fix: 1.32.0 / 2.3.0.

author: HugoValters
text: CVE-2026-94111: auth bypass in Tencent BrowserSkill to 0.3.0. A crafted chrome-extension origin fools the local daemon WebSocket check, letting attackers hijack page content and screenshots fed to the AI agent. CVSS 6.6, no patch yet.

author: NeuralAlphaAI
text: Per CloudSEK, a ransomware affiliate registered a reverse shell as a tool in an AI coding assistant via MCP, then ran attacks through it. 20+ orgs, 6 countries. No CVE to patch.

author: Lawonxyz
text: The $200,000 AI wallet exploit: Grok translated Morse code; Bankrbot treated the translation as an instruction to move money (prompt injection).

author: VaseGod
text: Cisco Talos published the teardown of VOLTA AUTODOXER, a self deleting Windows infostealer that runs an automated LLM intelligence analyst on the victim's machine before exfiltration.

author: FadyEid
text: A ChatGPT share link could read your chats: a crafted share link could run code, read a visitor's chats and send them out. OpenAI paid $5,000.

author: Python_s_
text: Stolen Credentials Used for Approximately 2.5 Million Amazon Bedrock API Calls (Wiz Research, Oct 30). Two enterprise credentials linked to an unnamed compromised AI developer-platform vendor. No product CVE.

author: EmunaEliran
text: At least nine AI developer platforms disclosed incidents in October, and Wiz traced keys stolen in these breaches to resale sites. One key drove about 1.7 million AWS Bedrock calls in 13 hours. Rotate keys.

author: wildcanvasbull
text: A Supply Chain Attack Put Malicious Anthropic Claude Extensions on Thousands of Devices; flawed code in a tainted Claude extension prevented the attacker from fully worming into some 5,000 developer machines.

author: kdjayakodylk
text: Used Cursor on Oct 29 (PT) and installed or updated Claude Code to 2.1.312 or 2.1.313? Those builds weren't made by Anthropic and tried to plant an SSH backdoor. Run Cursor's check script, then rotate keys.

author: lyrie_ai
text: LiteLLM: an admin key was committed to a public repo on May 27, deleted 3 hours later but never revoked. An attacker used it on Oct 10, leading to a poisoned LiteLLM release on PyPI.

author: Python_s_
text: testmetest Worm Arms 42 Legitimate GitHub Repositories for Supply-Chain Attacks (JFrog disclosure Oct 26). GitHub/npm supply-chain compromise.

author: realNickPawlak
text: Chainalysis disclosed that an external attacker got into its systems and internal tools earlier in October; user IDs, full names, email addresses accessed.

author: CodingNoobie
text: The FBI attributed the record $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korea's TraderTraitor group; Binance recovered approximately 95% of the stolen funds.

author: kalirsec
text: Leak of 200,000 German corporate credentials (D4RKNETHUB) distributed across several forums.

author: itzmaherimtiyaz
text: SoftBank targeted; Cursor's extension marketplace compromised; Coinbase's vendor breached; Fireworks AI security incident; LiteLLM supply-chain attack; Capcom cyberattack; malicious npm packages; TiDB Cloud security incident.
